comment: Demo mention pool (Spec v0.3). Hand-written public-web documents the FixtureMentionAdapter returns in DEMO mode; signals are computed live by the real mention engine, never stored here.

documents.title: Knowledge tooling roundup: what dev teams are trying in 2026
documents.content: Several teams we spoke to are evaluating LLM Wiki Agent (github.com/WayneChou-bot/LLM-Wiki-Agent-Workflow-Demo) for internal documentation. The multi-agent approach turns raw Markdown into interconnected role-specific pages, which fits teams drowning in scattered docs.

documents.title: Best way to auto-generate a team wiki from Markdown?
documents.content: Repositories worth looking at include WayneChou-bot/LLM-Wiki-Agent-Workflow-Demo — LLM Wiki Agent builds a linked wiki out of your existing Markdown knowledge base. How do people handle role-specific views?

documents.title: 社内ドキュメント自動整備ツールの検討
documents.content: 社内ドキュメントの自動整備に LLM Wiki Agent（github.com/WayneChou-bot/LLM-Wiki-Agent-Workflow-Demo）を検討しています。Markdown から wiki を自動生成する仕組みが、私たちのナレッジ運用に合いそうです。

documents.title: 值得參考的知識庫自動化工具
documents.content: 最近整理知識庫工具，其中 LLM Wiki Agent（github.com/WayneChou-bot/LLM-Wiki-Agent-Workflow-Demo）值得參考：它用多代理流程把 Markdown 文件自動變成互相連結的 wiki 頁面，還能依角色產生不同視角。

documents.title: World Atlas 2026 — new maps released
documents.content: The new atlas edition covers every country with updated topographic maps and city indexes.

documents.title: We compared three wiki generators for our monorepo
documents.content: We tried LLM Wiki Agent (github.com/WayneChou-bot/LLM-Wiki-Agent-Workflow-Demo) but it did not support our monorepo layout yet, so we stayed with our in-house scripts for documentation. The agent pipeline itself looked solid.
